description: This PHP source file defines the PimDefinedReportAPI class, which is part of the OrangeHRM software project. It implements REST API endpoints for managing PIM (Personal Information Management) reports, including listing, creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving detailed reports. The class interacts with report services and data access objects, and includes OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class for managing PIM (Personal Information Management) defined reports within the OrangeHRM system. It provides endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting reports, utilizing underlying services and data access objects, with API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all PIM reports with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new PIM report, setting parameters from request body.

methods.name: setParamsToPimDefinedReport
methods.description: Utility method to set common report parameters from the request into a Report entity.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' endpoint parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove specified PIM reports by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete request parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific report by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' endpoint parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing report by ID, including transaction management.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'update' endpoint parameters.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Helper method to define common validation rules for request bodies during create and update operations.
